description: pvcompare compares photovoltaic technologies in a specified local energy system by running an energy-system optimisation. The GRECO project publishes Python source, package documentation and versioned releases. Users set a demand profile, photovoltaic technology characteristics, weather or generation profiles, economic assumptions and competing system components. Outputs compare operating and investment results for the selected PV options and local scenario. Geographic coverage and temporal detail come from the input site and time series, not a packaged global dataset. The source is public under AGPL-3.0. A limitation is that the model's relative technology results depend on technology costs and generation profiles; the README's old CI badge is marked deprecated, so users should check current installation instructions. pvcompare serves solar-system sizing and technology-choice studies. The catalogue's model-pypsa is a broader energy-system modelling option, not an underlying pvcompare component. No simulation or solar data were downloaded.
inputs: Local electricity demand and PV technology profiles
name: pvcompare photovoltaic technology comparison model
notes: G7 G7-1395. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
outputs: Optimised local energy-system and PV comparison results
